paragraph: Rockleigh is one of the smallest markets in Bergen County, and the last six months show it plainly: a single closing, at $2,830,000 against a $2,900,000 list, in 30 days. That was a six-bedroom, five-bath contemporary, which tells you the price level here is set by large custom homes on substantial lots rather than by anything resembling a typical suburban tract. One sale cannot support a trend read, so ignore month-to-month movement entirely and treat that number as a single data point, not a market direction. What matters in a town like this is timing. Inventory appears rarely, and when it does you are usually negotiating against the seller's patience rather than against a crowd of other buyers. If Rockleigh is on your list, the practical move is to get set up for alerts and be ready to act on short notice, because you may wait months for the next house that fits.
